headline: Two Phases for Supporting Industry on Electricity Costs
summary: Greece will provide support of up to €95 million in two phases to industry on eligible electricity consumption in 2026. The measure is aimed at easing energy costs for manufacturers.
why: Electricity is a major operating cost for energy-intensive industries, so state support measures affect their margins and competitiveness.
